errors.text: The baseline is materially mischaracterized: HfMoTaTiZr has a reported density of about 10.44 g/cm³ and approximately 11.6% room-temperature compressive fracture strain, not >12 g/cm³ and <5% ductility.
No cited evidence establishes that composition adjustment in Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr will produce discrete B2 precipitates, or that trace Cr will stabilize B2 rather than form a Laves phase.

The asserted universal VEC ductility boundary at 4.5–4.6 is unsupported by the supplied evidence and is unlikely to be sufficient without accounting for phase constitution, ordering, morphology, and processing.
The proposed density below 10 g/cm³ is not demonstrated by a specified composition or rule-of-mixtures calculation.
Tensile elongation is compared implicitly with baseline and target compressive fracture strain, making the proposed performance metrics non-equivalent.
